title: Person defined.
bodyText: Person means any individual, company, insurer, association, organization, group, reciprocal or interinsurance exchanges, partnership, business, trust, or corporation.
bodyHtml: §431:1-212  Person defined.  Person means any individual, company, insurer, association, organization, group, reciprocal or interinsurance exchanges, partnership, business, trust, or corporation. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
